issues.contextReason: EQ-26 is currently normal and has a notable recent recurrence pattern for class B issues.

issues.description: Process measurements show a recurring gradual drift beyond the usual operating band, with intermittent inspection variation at the equipment output.
issues.suggestedResponseAction: Isolate affected flow, check sensing and alignment conditions, make a controlled adjustment, then restart and verify stable readings with inspection checks.
issues.contextReason: EQ-04 is currently normal and has the highest recent recurrence count for a class B issue.

issues.description: Process sensing indicates a recurring drift in output alignment, with recent units intermittently falling outside the expected inspection window.
issues.suggestedResponseAction: Isolate affected flow, inspect sensing and alignment conditions, make the necessary adjustment, then restart and verify stable results.
issues.contextReason: EQ-51 has a notable recent recurrence history for class A issues while currently reporting normal status.

issues.description: Process sensing indicates a sustained drift beyond the normal operating band, with intermittent inspection deviations requiring immediate attention.
issues.suggestedResponseAction: Isolate affected flow, check sensing and alignment conditions, make necessary adjustments, and verify stable readings before restart.
issues.contextReason: EQ-03 has a notable recurrence history for class A issues and is currently in NORMAL status.

issues.suggestedResponseAction: Inspect the prior temporary repair and restore stable operation.

issues.description: Material flow has become intermittent, with brief gaps causing downstream sensing to register inconsistent timing.
issues.suggestedResponseAction: Inspect the material path and sensing area, clear any buildup or obstruction, adjust alignment as needed, then restart at a controlled rate and verify stable flow.
issues.contextReason: EQ-26 is eligible with NORMAL status and has a notable recent recurrence of class B issues.

issues.suggestedResponseAction: Inspect the prior temporary repair and restore stable operation.
